PLAN "12-week Cardiac-Safe General Fitness"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general strength, aerobic capacity, and functional fitness while staying within cardiac-safe limits"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Full-body Circuit - Low Intensity":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_push_press_machine 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up_box 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_pallof_press 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Aerobic & Core":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          recumbent_cycle 1x20..25 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          standing_single_leg_balance 2x20..30 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Strength - Moderate Loads":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_press_machine 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pull_down 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_dumbbell_shoulder_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          supported_single_arm_row 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
